name: IL2 inducible T cell kinase

function.text: ITK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ITK/TSK. Annotated molecular activities include non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to lymphoproliferative syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: ITK encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ITK/TSK. Based in part on similarity, it is a tyrosine kinase that plays an essential role in regulation of the adaptive immune response. It regulates the development, function and differentiation of conventional T-cells and nonconventional NKT-cells. It phosphorylates 2 essential adapter proteins: the linker for activation of T-cells/LAT protein and LCP2.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with lymphoproliferative syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ITK have been reported in nodal t-follicular helper cell lymphoma.
